name: Frosthowl
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
narrative.objectives: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village
narrative.offerRewardText: Yer a real lifesaver, Leif!My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
narrative.requestItemsText: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
